attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"They carried Joska home to Cinder Rest on a door","severity":"minor","reason":"The briefing never says the body was recovered from the Lancer-held camp."},{"span":"his knuckles still split from the fight","severity":"minor","reason":"Added physical detail not in the briefing."},{"span":"unwound the fighting wraps from her father's hands","severity":"minor","reason":"An invented item, though it is in keeping with his pit-fighter backstory."}],"voice":5,"clarity":5,"tone":5,"overall":4,"comment":"A restrained, well-observed scene: the inherited wraps, too long for her wrists, show grief and resolve without naming either, and it ends cleanly on Tamsin's intent.
